entry_condition: Chest discomfort or new dyspnea suggesting ischaemic cause
outcome_description: Route to ACS vs SIHD differentiation. If rest pain or new severe → ESCALATE to emergency. If exertional stable → GOTO_PATHWAY(STABLE_ANGINA)

entry_condition: Palpitations or syncope suggesting arrhythmia
outcome_description: Differentiate AF vs SVT vs VT vs bradyarrhythmia. If syncope with palpitations → ESCALATE. If AF pattern → GOTO_PATHWAY(ATRIAL_FIBRILLATION)

entry_condition: Unilateral leg swelling with dyspnoea suggesting PE or DVT
outcome_description: Wells score pre-test probability. If high probability + haemodynamic instability → ESCALATE. If intermediate → GOTO_PATHWAY(IMAGING_CTPA)

entry_condition: Pleuritic chest pain — sharp pain worse on inspiration
outcome_description: Differentiate pericarditis vs pleuritis vs pneumothorax vs PE. If sudden onset with dyspnoea → RED_FLAG(RF_PNEUMOTHORAX). If fever + cough → GOTO_PATHWAY(PNEUMONIA)

entry_condition: Chronic cough with wheeze or breathlessness
outcome_description: Differentiate asthma vs COPD vs bronchiectasis. Smoking history and spirometry pattern branch to specific pathway.

entry_condition: Episodic wheeze with cough and chest tightness
outcome_description: Assess severity and trigger history. If acute severe with no bronchodilator response → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Chronic productive cough in smoker with progressive dyspnoea
outcome_description: Assess COPD severity and exacerbation status. If acute decompensation with SpO2 <92% → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Chronic daily productive cough with recurrent infections
outcome_description: Assess sputum characteristics and infection frequency. HRCT confirmation pathway.

entry_condition: Cough persisting more than 8 weeks without clear cause
outcome_description: Differentiate UACS vs GERD vs non-asthmatic eosinophilic bronchitis vs ACE inhibitor cough.

entry_condition: Persistent cough or haemoptysis in smoker over 40
outcome_description: Two-week-wait referral criteria check. Any haemoptysis + smoking history → urgent CXR + referral.

entry_condition: Breathlessness with organic antigen exposure history
outcome_description: Assess antigen exposure and temporal link. Progressive fibrosis → GOTO_PATHWAY(ILD_FIBROSIS)

entry_condition: Snoring and daytime sleepiness suggesting OSA
outcome_description: STOP-BANG screening. If severe with driving risk → RED_FLAG(RF_DRIVING_IMPAIRMENT). Refer to sleep clinic.

entry_condition: Recurrent chest infections since childhood with malabsorption
outcome_description: Sweat test and CFTR genotyping pathway. Known CF with acute decompensation → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Yellow discolouration of skin or eyes
outcome_description: Classify pre-hepatic vs hepatic vs post-hepatic. Dark urine + pale stool → GOTO_PATHWAY(CHOLESTATIC_JAUNDICE). Encephalopathy → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Jaundice with dark urine and pale stools
outcome_description: Obstruction vs intrahepatic cholestasis. Biliary colic history → GOTO_PATHWAY(BILIARY). RUQ pain + fever → GOTO_PATHWAY(ACUTE_CHOLECYSTITIS)

entry_condition: Neonatal jaundice beyond 14 days or with pale stools
outcome_description: Exclude biliary atresia — KASAI procedure window. Refer urgently for hepatobiliary workup.

entry_condition: Jaundice in neonate — assess onset timing and severity
outcome_description: Onset <24h → ESCALATE (haemolytic disease). Day 3-14 physiological. >14 days → GOTO_PATHWAY(CONJUGATED_JAUNDICE)

entry_condition: Abdominal distension with fluid shift on percussion
outcome_description: SAAG-guided classification. Fever + abdominal tenderness → RED_FLAG(RF_SBP). Haematemesis → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Right upper quadrant pain suggesting biliary cause
outcome_description: Differentiate biliary colic vs cholecystitis vs choledocholithiasis. Charcot's triad → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Episodic colicky RUQ pain related to fatty food
outcome_description: Self-limiting colicky pain without fever. Confirm gallstones on ultrasound. Elective cholecystectomy pathway.

entry_condition: Constant RUQ pain with fever and positive Murphy's sign
outcome_description: Tokyo Grade assessment. Severe with sepsis → ESCALATE. Moderate → urgent surgical referral.

entry_condition: Jaundice + RUQ pain + fever (Charcot's triad)
outcome_description: Charcot's triad → ascending cholangitis → ESCALATE for emergency ERCP.

entry_condition: Jaundice with hepatitis B exposure or serology
outcome_description: HBsAg + HBeAg + HBV DNA assessment. Acute liver failure → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Abnormal LFTs temporally linked to new medication
outcome_description: Hy's Law criteria. If jaundice + elevated INR → RED_FLAG(RF_LIVER_FAILURE). Withdraw offending drug.

entry_condition: Urethral discharge or genital symptoms with sexual exposure
outcome_description: NAAT for Chlamydia + gonorrhoea. Partner notification. Systemic features → ESCALATE for disseminated infection.

entry_condition: Gradual-onset scrotal pain with fever
outcome_description: Exclude torsion first. Gradual onset + dysuria + STI risk → antibiotic pathway. Systemic sepsis → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Painless firm intratesticular mass
outcome_description: Scrotal ultrasound + tumour markers (AFP/hCG/LDH). Urgent urology referral.

entry_condition: Obstructive or irritative lower urinary tract symptoms
outcome_description: IPSS score. BPH vs prostate cancer vs bladder pathology. Rising PSA → GOTO_PATHWAY(PROSTATE_CANCER)

entry_condition: Obstructive LUTS with elevated PSA or bone pain in older male
outcome_description: PSA + DRE + imaging. Bone pain with spinal cord symptoms → ESCALATE. Elevated PSA → multi-parametric MRI + biopsy.

entry_condition: New axial bone pain in known or suspected cancer patient
outcome_description: Bone scan + CT. Back pain with leg weakness → ESCALATE for malignant spinal cord compression.

entry_condition: Constitutional symptoms suggesting possible malignancy
outcome_description: Systematic cancer screen: bloods + CXR + USS abdomen. B-symptoms → GOTO_PATHWAY(LYMPHOMA)

entry_condition: Risk factor positive with symptom suggesting malignancy
outcome_description: Expedited investigation pathway. Two-week-wait referral criteria.

entry_condition: Family history of cancer with presenting symptom
outcome_description: Genetic risk assessment. Lynch syndrome / BRCA / FAP screening. Early colonoscopy or genetic counselling referral.

entry_condition: Rectal bleeding in patient over 40 or with associated symptoms
outcome_description: Two-week-wait colonoscopy criteria. With weight loss or change in bowel habit → urgent referral.

entry_condition: Iron deficiency anaemia without obvious cause
outcome_description: Exclude GI malignancy. Bidirectional endoscopy in males and post-menopausal females.

entry_condition: Change in bowel habit with rectal bleeding
outcome_description: Two-week-wait referral for colonoscopy. FOB test + staging CT if confirmed.

entry_condition: Painless lymphadenopathy with or without B-symptoms
outcome_description: Blood film + LDH + urgent haematology referral. PET-CT for staging.

entry_condition: B-symptom triad: fever + night sweats + weight loss >10%
outcome_description: Urgent haematology referral. B-symptoms indicate advanced or aggressive lymphoma.

entry_condition: Acute confusion with fluctuating course in elderly patient
outcome_description: 4AT or CAM assessment. Identify and treat precipitant. Severe agitation → ESCALATE

entry_condition: Progressive memory loss affecting daily function
outcome_description: MMSE / MoCA cognitive testing. Exclude reversible causes (B12, TFT, CT brain). Memory clinic referral.

entry_condition: Subjective or objective memory or executive function decline
outcome_description: Assess for MCI vs early dementia vs depression. Reversible cause screen.

entry_condition: New symptom temporally linked to medication in elderly patient
outcome_description: Beers Criteria / STOPP review. Active bleeding → ESCALATE. Confusion from ADR → GOTO_PATHWAY(DELIRIUM)

entry_condition: Polypharmacy or drug interaction concern
outcome_description: Structured medication review using STOPP/START. Deprescribe inappropriate drugs.

entry_condition: Systemic features suggesting acute infection
outcome_description: Identify focus of infection. Sepsis features → ESCALATE. Unknown focus → directed investigation.

entry_condition: Constitutional symptoms without clear focus
outcome_description: Screen for malignancy, chronic infection, autoimmune, endocrine. B-symptoms → GOTO_PATHWAY(LYMPHOMA).

entry_condition: Steatorrhoea with malabsorption symptoms
outcome_description: Faecal elastase. Manage exocrine pancreatic insufficiency with PERT. CF → GOTO_PATHWAY(CYSTIC_FIBROSIS)
